text:
marie: Heads up — helm upgrade of chart `redwood/gpupool` (v2.8.1 -> v2.9.0) is stuck in a post-upgrade hook in prod. The hook Job pods are Pending with NetworkPolicy egress denies, so the job never finishes and the release is blocked. GitOps reconciler is now showing drift and we can't scale the gpupool.

sam: seeing this in canary too or just prod?

marie: only prod so far. canary already on 2.9.0 and healthy. PR #4321 (infra) that tightened network-policies landed this morning — likely cause.

kai: digging in — the hook Job runs in `gpupool-system` namespace and uses a transient SA `gpupool-hook-sa`. The cluster has a default-deny egress NP that doesn't allow that SA to reach our image registry + metadata endpoints. Job events: 

```
NormalScheduled  2m  default-scheduler  Successfully assigned gpupool-system/gpupool-upgrade-hook-7x9k to node-abc
Warning  FailedCreatePodSandBox  2m  kubelet  Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = NetworkPlugin cni failed to set up pod: pod rejected by NetworkPolicy: egress to 10.0.0.0/8 denied
```

ashley: quick workaround — create a temporary NetworkPolicy that allows egress from the hook SA to the registry + K8s API endpoints and re-run the hook. Alternatively, patch the hook Job manifest in the chart to add `networking.gke.io/egress: 'allow'` (we don't have that annotation globally) or run `helm rollback` to v2.8.1 while we patch infra.

ops-bot: [deploy] helm upgrade redwood/gpupool --namespace gpupool-system v2.9.0 -> post-upgrade hook waiting (job/gpupool-upgrade-hook) 

luis: I'm going to push a tiny permissive NP scoped to the `gpupool-system` namespace that only allows egress to our registry (quay.redwood.com) and instance-metadata IPs. Will post the patch and revert after.

olivia: FYI cost note — if this blocks scaling for >30m and autoscaler falls back to spinning up on-demand instead of spot, we could see a short-term 20-40% cost bump on affected clusters. Keep an eye on autoscaler logs.

sam: if we add permissive NP, will GitOps complain? We should add the NP patch as a short-lived PR to the infra repo so it goes through auditing and we can revert via GitOps after.

marie: good call. luis — can you open infra PR and ping sec? mark as emergency revert. I'll run the helm hook once it's live.

luis: PR done: infra#4378 — temporary np allowing egress to quay.redwood.com and 169.254.169.254, namespace selector gpupool-system, expires in 2h. tagging @sec @platform.

kai: after NP applied I re-triggered the helm post-upgrade hook with `helm test --cleanup` and the job completed. Release progressed to v2.9.0. GitOps reconciler shows no drift now.

ops-bot: [deploy] helm test gpupool-system v2.9.0 -> PASS (hook job completed)

olivia: confirmed autoscaler remained on spot for most nodes; small slice fell back but recovered. cost delta negligible for this incident.

ashley: action items: 1) add explicit egress allow rules for chart hook jobs or document requirement in chart README, 2) add CI check that pre-flight hook pods can reach registry in upgrades, 3) make NP change via GitOps PR template that supports emergency rollouts.

marie: agreed. I'll own a short postmortem doc and link infra#4378 and the helm release logs. Thanks for fast turnaround :thumbsup:
